mechanism_narrative: Sustained recovery in TRANSIT mobility signals a return to pre-pandemic commuting and leisure travel routines, which increases footfall at retail and recreation venues and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -38.1 at t-3w to -33.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite TRANSIT continuing to improve or stay above -35.

mechanism_narrative: A steady rise in WORKPLACES mobility indicates that office and workplace attendance is recovering, which drives weekday retail and food-service footfall and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -34.7 at t-3w to -28.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days even though WORKPLACES mobility improves or stays above -30.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM mobility crosses above -8 percent, it signals that essential-shopping anxiety has eased and normal shopping routines are returning, which spills over into discretionary retail and raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses above -8.0 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM recovered from -11.0 at t-3w to -9.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks when GROCERY_PHARM is above -8.0, RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is not higher than its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility crosses above zero, outdoor recreation becomes a substitute for indoor retail trips, diverting consumer time away from shops and pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses above 0.0 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS spiked to +0.9 at t-2w before falling to -10.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: In weeks when PARKS is above 0.0, RETAIL_REC over the following 7 days is not lower than its prior 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Joint improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility indicates broad reopening; the two series reinforce each other, producing a larger increase in retail and recreation footfall than either series alone, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improved from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve for two consecutive weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Falling RESIDENTIAL mobility combined with rising TRANSIT mobility indicates that people are leaving home more often and traveling further, which increases exposure to retail venues and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 7.0 and TRANSIT rises above -35.0
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 9.6 to 6.7 and TRANSIT rose from -38.1 to -33.0
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL is below 7.0 and TRANSIT is above -35.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In an easing-restrictions regime defined by TRANSIT above -35 and WORKPLACES above -30, policy relaxation permits more retail and recreation activity, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks; if either threshold fails, the mechanism is inactive.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT > -35 and WORKPLACES > -30 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -33.0 and WORKPLACES at -28.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT is above -35 and WORKPLACES is above -30, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the previous 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal spring weather raises PARKS mobility, and when PARKS rises sharply while RETAIL_REC is flat, consumers shift leisure time from indoor retail to outdoor recreation, reducing RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was volatile (-15.1, 0.9, -12.6, -10.7) while RETAIL_REC stayed near -28
failure_condition: When PARKS rises by more than 5 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is not lower than its prior 14-day mean.
